description.text: I. Professional OverviewClinical medicine is a medical science that studies the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases. It takes human diseases as its research object and clinical practice as its core, aiming to cultivate high-quality medical talents who possess the basic theories and practical skills of basic medicine and clinical medicine and can engage in medical treatment, prevention, medical research and other work in medical and health units, medical research and other departments. Students need to systematically master the occurrence and development patterns of diseases, acquire the basic skills for diagnosing and treating diseases, possess good professional ethics, critical thinking and lifelong learning abilities, and be able to provide scientific and standardized medical services to patients in clinical practice.Ii. Curriculum System1. Basic medical coursesMedical basic theories: Human anatomy (systematic anatomy, local anatomy), histology and embryology, Physiology, biochemistry and molecular biology, medical microbiology, medical immunology, Pathology, Pathophysiology.Basic experimental courses: Anatomy experiment, Physiology Experiment, Pathology Experiment. Master the principles of basic medicine through observing tissue sections under a microscope, animal experiments, etc.2. Core courses of clinical medicineDiagnostics: Medical history collection, physical examination, laboratory tests (such as blood routine, biochemical indicators), imaging diagnosis (X-ray, CT, MRI).Internal medicine: Etiology, pathology, diagnosis and treatment of common diseases in the cardiovascular system, respiratory system, digestive system, urinary system, etc. (such as hypertension, pneumonia, diabetes).Surgery: Aseptic operation, basic surgical skills, surgical treatment and perioperative management of surgical diseases in various systems (such as appendicitis, fractures, tumors).Obstetrics and Gynecology and Pediatrics: Pregnancy physiology, gynecological diseases (such as uterine fibroids), normal delivery and difficult labor management; Diagnosis and treatment of children's growth and development and common pediatric diseases (such as pneumonia and diarrhea).Other clinical courses: Neurology, Psychiatry, Infectious Diseases, ophthalmology, Otolaryngology, Dermatology and venereology, etc.3. Preventive Medicine and Humanities CoursesPreventive medicine: Epidemiology (disease distribution and prevention strategies), Health Statistics, Occupational Health and Environmental Health.Medical humanities: Medical ethics (such as doctor-patient communication, informed consent), medical psychology, Health Law (handling of medical disputes).4. Practical teaching linkClinical internship: Starting from the junior year, students enter the hospital and follow their supervising doctors to participate in outpatient and ward rounds, learning skills in consultation and physical examination (such as internal medicine internship and surgery internship).Clinical Internship: From the senior to the senior year, a one-year systematic internship is conducted, rotating through at least 10 departments including internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, and emergency department. Patients are independently managed, medical records are written, and basic diagnostic and treatment operations (such as suturing and puncturing) are participated in.Graduation internship and Thesis: Complete the graduation thesis based on clinical cases, such as the clinical analysis or treatment plan research of a certain disease.

duration.text: The MBBS at Jinan University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. [Application Form] "Application Form for Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, Overseas Chinese, Chinese and Other Foreign Students of Jinan University and Huaqiao University" Log in to the application system, complete the application and print it out (with your signature attached).2. [Passport] The student's own passport (if currently in China, the most recent valid Chinese visa page and entry and exit record stamp must also be provided).3. [Graduation Certificate] and [Transcript] (Note ①, ②)Graduation certificates or academic qualifications of high school or above, transcripts of each academic year issued by the graduating high school, and transcripts of internationally recognized standardized tests (if available, provide such as SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB, etc.).4. [Language Proficiency Proof] HSK or IELTS, TOEFL score certificates, etc. (The scores are valid within two years).5. [Personal Statement] Self-introduction, past study experience and study plan in China.6. [Recommendation Letter] One letter, which can be recommended by our overseas admissions office, local overseas Chinese communities, well-known figures in the overseas Chinese community, or the high school where the student graduated.7. [Physical Examination Report] If you are applying for a medical-related program at our school, you also need to provide a physical examination report within the last six months. The template for the physical examination report is attached as the "Physical Examination Form".8. The date of issuance of the "Certificate of No Criminal Record" should be within six months before the registration date.9. [Other Materials] According to the "Notice of the Ministry of Education on Regulating the Relevant Work of Accepting International Students in Our Higher Education Institutions" (Jiaowai Han [2020] No. 12),② Proof of the applicant's acquisition of foreign nationality; ③ The applicant's entry and exit records for the past four years (up to April 30, 2025).(2) For applicants who acquired foreign nationality at birth abroad, if one or both of their parents are Chinese citizens, they need to provide ① proof that the applicant acquired foreign nationality at birth; ② Proof of permanent residence of the applicant's parents (Chinese citizens) in a foreign country before birth; ③ The applicant's entry and exit records for the past four years (up to April 30, 2025).

requirements.text: All Chinese and other foreign students (non-Chinese citizens) who have a high school diploma or equivalent educational attainment, are at least 18 years old but no more than 25 years old, have good conduct, no criminal record, and are in good physical and mental health are eligible to apply for Jinan University.
